author: dodgerXyz
body:
So,

 I was enjoying myself while playing avicade, One in the chamber comes up and i was so happy, it was one of my favorites. Then like a minute into the game i lose a life and re-spawn, someone has their bow pointed straight at my face and shoots me, then i re-spawn and it happens again, i lose 7 lives to it. I say there be a spawn protection so that players can enjoy themselves.


Thanks for reading-
dodgerXyz
